title: TNTFireworks
description: TNTFireworks is a plugin that transforms TNT explosions into harmless fireworks.
body:
🎆 TNTFireworks: Spectacular Explosions Without Damage!

TNTFireworks transforms every TNT explosion into a stunning firework display, replacing destruction with beauty! Perfect for survival servers, this plugin ensures that TNT no longer damages blocks, so your builds and landscapes stay safe while still enjoying the excitement of explosions.

✨ Key Features
	•	🔥 Full Support: Works with both TNT blocks and TNT Minecarts.
	•	🛠️ Total Customization: Easily adjust firework effects, explosion styles, and more using a simple configuration file.
	•	🔔 Automatic Updates: Get notified of new versions and update automatically for a hassle-free experience.

🎉 Why Use TNTFireworks?
	•	🛡️ Protect Your World: Prevents TNT from destroying blocks, eliminating griefing and accidental damage—ideal for community and creative servers.
	•	🎇 Amazing Visuals: Every explosion becomes a colorful firework show, making your server more fun and visually appealing.
	•	🤝 Player-Friendly: Encourages safe use of TNT, so players can experiment and play without fear of ruining builds.
	•	⚙️ Customizable Experience: Tailor the effects to fit your server’s unique style or special events.
	•	🚀 Lightweight & Efficient: Designed to run smoothly without impacting server performance.

⚙️ Compatibility
Supports Spigot & Paper, from version 1.8 to 1.20.4. Native Minecraft version: 1.21.

📖 Full Documentation
For a detailed guide on installation, configuration, and commands, check out the documentation linked on the resource page.

Transform explosions into celebrations and keep your world safe with TNTFireworks!
